name: language-coach
description: Writing feedback on every prompt you type, in the language you are practising: a small model reviews it out of band and the fixes appear under your prompt, never in the main conversation.

targetLanguage.title: Language you practise
targetLanguage.description: The language your prompts are coached in. Prompts written in another language are left alone.

nativeLanguage.title: Your native language
nativeLanguage.description: Helps the coach spot transfer errors (false friends, calques, prepositions) from your native language.

model.title: Coach model
model.description: The model that reviews each prompt. Haiku is fast and cheap; the main session's model is never used.

minLength.title: Minimum prompt length
minLength.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters are not coached.

maxLength.title: Maximum prompt length
maxLength.description: Prompts longer than this many characters (usually pasted logs or documents) are not coached.

enabled.title: Coach my prompts
enabled.description: Turn the coach off without uninstalling it. /language-coach off pauses it for the current session only.

statusLine.title: Status-line counter
statusLine.description: Show today's fixes and your clean-prompt streak under the prompt box.
